subject: POC wrap-up: BrightBox metrics & brief testimonial request
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightbox.ai>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@brightbox.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC wrap-up: BrightBox metrics & brief testimonial request

Hi Elena / Carlos,

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. We walked through the results during Friday's demo, but I wanted to capture the key operational outcomes and follow up with a small ask. Short recap below (pulled from the attached PDF):

- Latency: 95th percentile reduced from ~320ms to ~120ms on 1k-token workloads with the Redwood runtime and batching.
- Cost per 1k tokens: estimated 38% reduction after prefix caching + quantization profile.
- Throughput: sustained inference throughput increased ~2.8x for your peak batch 30 tests.
- Error rate: transient 5xxs during early config were eliminated after the stability patch on day 3.

Attachments: BrightBox_POC_summary_20260328.pdf (detailed metrics + config), latency_kpi_screenshot.png (95/50/median charts).

If these numbers look right to you, would BrightBox be willing to:
1) Serve as a short customer reference (we'd include BrightBox name and a 1-2 sentence quote in a short case blurb), and/or
2) Do a 10–15 minute call with a Redwood product marketer to record a brief testimonial we can use on our website and one-pager?

Example (feel free to edit): "Redwood's runtime cut our inference latency and cost materially during the POC, enabling us to hit production SLAs at half the expected spend."

If you're open to this, please either reply with a sentence we can use as a quote or suggest a convenient 10–15 minute slot next week. Also let me know whether the logo usage needs any legal sign-off — we can route that through your legal contact.

Thanks — really excited about the results and the next steps for production onboarding.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0186
